_comment: The App Store build's image runtime (adr/0018 §4): our mflux fork (branch llmtray, from v.0.20.0), which imports OpenCV and torch only where they're used (ControlNet/OpenPose preprocessors, PyTorch-format weights). The MLX-native models LLMTray runs -- z-image-turbo, FLUX.2 klein -- need neither, so mflux is installed without its dependencies and then with every one but 'exclude': opencv-python bundles FFmpeg built with --enable-gpl (x264, x265), which the App Store build can't ship; torch is ~400 MB nothing calls. 'extra': what torch used to bring along that transformers' chat templates need. The standalone build keeps pip-installing mflux==MfluxManager.mfluxVersion from PyPI on the user's Mac. Its pins apply to the whole App Store package set (one resolution with the mlx-lm fork and mlx-audio): mflux 0.20.0 wants mlx >=0.32,<0.33, so moving the mlx-lm fork to mlx 0.33 needs a newer mflux here too.
